name: Union Senate
promotion_note: World Bible; core GU legislative body. CANON.
policy_fault_line: The Senate debates whether to implement economic controls or trust market forces to stabilize prices. That is the Trade Coalition question in legislative form: a chamber where many senators are backed by Coalition interests deciding whether to constrain the markets those interests hold.

notable_statute.law: The Union Senate has outlawed certain simulations depicting past wars and atrocities.
notable_statute.violation: AI warlords create rogue versions of them, treating history as a tactical study.
notable_statute.significance: A memory law and its evasion. The Union restricts the reenactment of its own atrocities; its adversaries mine exactly that material for advantage.

speaker.title: Speaker of the Union Senate
speaker.note: Recorded elsewhere as High Chancellor Renn Valcor; the Speaker role is the office attested here.

fiscal_power: Sets the Union Marshals budget and can increase or cut their funding — the limit already recorded on org_union_marshals.institutional_independence.
